description: Calculate exact concrete volume (cubic yards, cubic feet and cubic metres) with waste allowance, ready-mix cost and number of 80 lb, 60 lb, 40 lb or 25 kg bags needed for slabs, footings, square columns and round piers. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/concrete-calculator.

lengthOrHeight.description: Length (slab/footing) or height (columns) in ft or m

pricePerUnit.description: Optional ready-mix price per yd3 (imperial) or m3 (metric)

thicknessOrDepth.description: Thickness/depth in in or cm (required for slab, footing, column)

widthOrDiameter.description: Width (slab: ft/m; footing/column: in/cm) or diameter (round: in/cm)
